name: The Metaphysicist
description: This thing on? Hi! I'm Dr. Zenon, expert on dimensional technology and particle physics. I've been assigned to your research team because there's apparently some unexplainable phenomena going on. I should be capable of dealing with things just on the brink of what science can explain.

quests.name: Strange Crystals
quests.description: Strange, these crystals you found have no equivalent mineral in our database. They seem to be more of a vessel for a concept instead of an explicit substance. The white ones, for instance, seem to arrange themselves in an orderly manner when left alone, and the orange ones are always warm to the touch. Most of these crystals slowly crumble when performing those actions, so there's no breaking the laws of physics, at least.

tasks.longDescription: You have obtained the following item:

quests.name: It came to you in a dream?!
quests.description: So apparetly, something or someone wanted us to find this. It's already got writing in it, so someone must have come before us. I strongly suggest you start doing your own research from now on. This might quickly become more extensive than my small corner of the lab can handle.

tasks.longDescription: You have obtained the following item:

quests.name: Melting Pot
quests.description: Did you know that you can make cauldrons from both iron and black bronze? might prove useful for this "crucible" thing the book is referencing. Due to the immense powers attributed to it, you might want to desinfect the water first, don't want any microbes to contaminate our work. Simply put fresh water in a barrel together with some copper.

tasks.longDescription: Show me that you have made the following items:

quests.name: Void Metal
quests.description: This stuff you found is disturbing. Fascinating, but deeply disturbing. I bet its self-repairing properties can be applied to many things. Hey, Collins wants you to automate steel production, don't they? Perhaps you could apply some void metal to a tuyere to make it last forever...

tasks.longDescription: You have obtained the following item:
I'd like some for further testing, both in the lab and for ship repairs. We might save ourselves some dangerous work up here if we coud use void metal instead of rigid steel.

quests.name: Magical High-Octane Fuel
quests.description: This Alumentum stuff is really interesting. not only can it burn for long amounts of time in a furnace, charcoal forge or the likes, it also explodes if you throw it too hard. might be useful for anything that requires explosions when you don't have any gunpowder lying around, like making compressed iron. If you control the heat precisely, you can even liquefy it, resulting in a fuel with similar properties as Diesel normally has.

tasks.longDescription: You have obtained the following item:

quests.name: Automated Alchemy
quests.description: Throwing stuff at your crucible is hardly the way to move forward, and letting a dropper throw in the catalyst doesn't quite seem to work. I'm reading here that there's supposed to be some sort of device that can automate that task for you. It will require a few alchemical constructs though which are a bit complex for your tools right now. Perhaps Collins' Miniaturization crafting could help you out.

tasks.longDescription: Show me that you have made the following items:

quests.name: Crystal Samples
quests.description: I'd love to examine these under the microscope, see if there's more to them than meets the eye. you mind shipping me a sample of every regular type? You'll probably need them all later anyway.

quests.name: Automating Lava
quests.description: Now that you have access to Ember Power, I bet your Lava demands are through the roof. If you don't want to pump the nether dry, consider consulting your Thaumonomicon for some ideas. maybe there's something in it that could help you out.

tasks.longDescription: Show me that you have made the following item:

quests.name: Distilling Essentia
quests.description: The Crucible is all well and good for basic alchemy, but I feel like we can make this "essentia" do more things than converting items you throw in. The first step would be to get it out of the water and distill it into pure form. Think you can do that?

tasks.longDescription: Show me that you have obtained the following items:

quests.name: Automating Core Extraction
quests.description: I've heard that Manders wants to make use of these core extractors to power his industrial endeavors as the heat they contain is somehow supernaturally efficient, but you're having trouble extracting it automatically, don't you? Tell you what, I think i've got it figured out: So you might have realized that mechanical users have too short of a reach to grab the thermal cells from the transfer unit. Turns out, one of your new golem helpers with the "use" seal can do so just fine! just tell it to only click on the transfer unit from above and with an empty cell in its hand. then, turn redstone sensitivity on the seal on and attach a scanner that observes the "Transfer" blockstate. a repeater or two may be needed since the transfer unit is known to oscillate between transfering and not transfering. You will need a second thermal cell for this, as a quick heads-up.

quests.name: Arcane Measurements
quests.description: A Thaumometer, you say? Well, i might want one for myself, see if it's much different from other optical tools like a microscope. I'd also like a copy of your thaumonomicon to conduct some tests on and archive any discoveries you make.

tasks.longDescription: Send me the following items: (you might want to hold off on this until you have spares)

quests.name: Applied Solipsism
quests.description: If a tree falls in a forest while noone's around to hear it, does it make a sound? Trick question. From what i've gathered, if noone's around to observe something on this planet, there's a high likelihood of it just sorta.. freezing in time. Some plants and devices can resist this effect, but often to your detriment: blast furnaces will go out, your metal gets cold, and the crops grow while the harvesting mechanism stays motionless, and the metaphorical tree can't even fall. But don't worry, i've come up with something: If you use an ender pearl and socket it into an obsidian totem, it will act as a mimic for a conscious observer, allowing time to pass like normal. Well, at least i hope it's just mimicking consciousness... It is a very short-sighted observer though and requires fuel like glowstone, more ender pearls, or salis mundus. If you put one in a minecart, it will allow your trains to cross vast distances without you having to worry about the whole track being monitored.

tasks.longDescription: Show me that you've obtained the following item:

quests.name: Essentia Motor
quests.description: Manders told me about how desperately he'd need you to get some rotary power going. Since steam seems to require a more stable heat source like ember, i figured that it would be just out of your reach for now. But with pure distillates of the very concepts of power and locomotion at your disposal, i bet that you can come up with something.

tasks.longDescription: Show us that you are capable of making mechanical power:

quests.name: Highway to Hell
quests.description: Now, most planets aren't connected to the nether like our homeworld, but since this place is so absurd we might aswell try. If you haven't got a black steel pickaxe yet, i would advise you cast it using buckets. Just be careful not to mess it up. If we're really lucky, we could use the portal as a means to escape directly back home!

tasks.longDescription: Show me footage of completing this milestone:

quests.name: [i] What lies below
quests.description: Either something happened to it while we were away, or this place has an entirely different nether to the one we're familiar with. all sorts of new structures, flora, and ores. It also means that it's not a way to get back home, probably. The reed that grows here is really interesting, though. It possesses many attributes that regular sugar cane has, including its rapid growth, well, at least rapid in comparison to all the plants you've been cultivating down there thusfar. It can also be made into paper like any other variant.
